dedupe_keys.name: earthquake hazard reduction for critical facilities equipment isolation shake table test nees 2010 0923

description: This DEEDSHub dataset documents a NEES payload shake-table test of an isolation system for equipment, part of research on reducing earthquake hazard for critical facilities such as hospitals and data centres whose equipment must keep working. The project was led by Henri Gavin of Duke University (NSF award 0704959, 2007 to 2010) and tested at the University of California, San Diego, as a payload on the shake-table programme of a precast floor diaphragm project; it was curated on DEEDSHub in 2017. It includes a report with sensor configuration, channel tags, time steps and units, time-history plots, objectives and outcomes, tab-delimited ASCII records of the measured time histories, and MATLAB functions to parse them; test videos were announced. Coverage: one isolation system in laboratory tests. Access: open download from DEEDSHub. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0; free for non-commercial use. Caveats: a single prototype isolation system. Simulation uses are validation of models of isolated equipment and the functionality of critical facilities in earthquakes. Related records: the NEES BNCS building test.
